title: reference manifest
description: data/references/<tier>/<dataset_id>/manifest.json: what a reference is, where it was promoted from and the checksum of each item's text. A reference is made only by promoting labels (ADR-0022): evh reference-promote writes it for a label set, evh reference-manifest for labels a script builds. Committed even when the text is not redistributed: validate's V16 checks the text present against it, and fails a reference with none.

dataset_id.description: The dataset it is a reference for: the directory's name, unless the dataset has a second reference of the tier under a name of its own (gold/ag_news_200_adj1 for ag_news_200).

actor.description: Who acted (RFC-027): a person, or an agent and the person it acted for. A recorded claim, not an identity.

for.description: the person an agent acted for

items_sha256.description: {item_id: sha256 of the item's reference text, as stored}.

caveat.description: What the tier is and where the labels came from, to show beside any number scored against it.

source.description: How to rebuild the text when it is built outside the harness or not redistributed: the script that fetches it (examples/<example>/fetch.py), or the commands that rebuild a label set and promote it again.

redistributed.description: false: the text is not in the repository (its licence, or the project's choice); the manifest proves a rebuilt copy is the same.

promoted_from.description: The labels it was promoted from: the label set (null for labels a script fetches, not held as a set here), the set's dataset and its source (person, model or rule; who, and how).

reason.description: Why these labels are the yardstick, given when they were promoted.

promoted_by.description: Who promoted them (null for a reference promoted when 0.6.0 migrated the references made before labels existed).

authored_by.description: For a model's labels: the config whose run wrote them. Hashed into every run's fingerprint: a run scored against a model's answers is graded against that model.

model.description: For a model's labels: the model that wrote them (hashed, as authored_by).

from_run.description: For a model's labels: the run they came from (its id, config, fingerprint hash and build; hashed, as authored_by).

authored_with.description: For a model's labels written before label sets existed: the adapter that wrote them (hashed, as authored_by).

system_under_test.description: For a model's labels written before label sets existed: the author's identity record, as its run wrote it (hashed, as authored_by).

params.description: For a model's labels written before label sets existed: the author's request options, credentials never (hashed, as authored_by).
